dimension_evidence.specification: H x W x D = 49 x 56 x 46 cm
dimension_evidence.uncertainty: Manufacturer metric dimensions rounded to centimetres; housing contours and interior offsets estimated from datasheet front/right view and facility photo. Inch dimensions differ slightly due rounding.

author: Virtual Lab project
license: Project-authored geometry; source reference documents retain their respective copyright.
notes: 8 independent optical channels and one 96-well sample plate supported by manufacturer datasheet.
Openable front/top hood, XY plate carriage and vertical sensor head are separate kinematic nodes. Motions are digital articulation; hardware travel and axis arrangement not calibrated.
Exact internal mechanics are not published in cited datasheet; hidden carriage structure is a functional visualization, not engineering reconstruction.
Desktop computer and external accessories excluded. No external automation adapter; manufacturer product listing says External Automation: No.
ChemLab and public exact-model community searches returned no verified downloadable Octet R8 model.
axis: X right, Y back, Z up in Blender; standard Y-up glTF export

review.method: Actual final-model render inspected beside facility/manufacturer reference; no photographic texture substitution
review.note: Curved white housing, black hinged window and yellow handle agree with facility photo; optical/XY internals are illustrative.
review.final_review_note: Final evaluated-geometry render reviewed after curve-envelope correction and modifier-preserving export. Shapes compared with the previously inspected facility/manufacturer contact sheets.
review.approval_policy: Visual approval binds to the exact exported GLB (geometry, materials, hierarchy and animation); PNG date/render-time metadata may change without changing the reviewed model.

surface_check.method: Actual evaluated vertices to triangles in both directions, closed pose; Euclidean metres; all posed transforms independently checked

assembly.units: m at asset root; local translation units follow accumulated parent scale
assembly.axis_metadata: joint_axis uses Blender Z-up node local coordinates; glTF Y-up equivalent is [x,z,-y]
